clarifications.subject: Thin-film swash dropout attribution on sloping bed (WG3, WG4)
clarifications.prior_assertion: Attributed high relative RMSE (0.3545 to 0.5645 H) directly to discrete SWL floor drops (-0.02 m) caused by MassLimit thresholding.
clarifications.scientific_qualification: Coincidence of discrete SWL floor drops with high RMSE is a testable scientific hypothesis, not mathematically proven root causality. Thin-film boundary layer dynamics, swash tip aerated spray, and contact line motion interact with the discrete gauge kernel.
clarifications.prospective_diagnostic_cohort: Cohort 3 (Thin-Sheet Swash Slope Probes) with conditional partitioning of continuous vs floor-clamped samples.

clarifications.subject: Flat-bed 12% relative RMSE attribution (WG1, WG2)
clarifications.prior_assertion: Attributed flat-bed ~12% relative RMSE to artificial viscosity scaling (nu_art ~ alpha * h * cs) and symplectic time-step phase lag.
clarifications.scientific_qualification: Artificial viscosity dissipation and time-step drift are physically grounded explanatory hypotheses, but not proven sole causes. Wave generation paddle displacement fidelity and boundary particle reflections also contribute.
clarifications.prospective_diagnostic_cohort: Cohort 1 (Continuous Deep-Water Flat-Bed Probes) with 100% wet occupancy to isolate wave envelope damping from floor effects.

governance_and_boundary_rules.family_disposition: No premature halting of the entire F5 family; automated solver launches paused pending diagnostic evidence review
